description: This PHP abstract class 'AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor' provides email processing functionalities related to leave requests in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for managing email subscribers, recipients based on roles, supervisors, leave details, and comments, as well as integrating various services and traits for utility functions.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveEmailProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that handles email notifications related to leave requests, providing methods to retrieve subscribers, recipients, leave details, comments, and integrating with leave and email services.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService, initializing it if needed.

methods.name: getSubscribersForEvent
methods.description: Fetches email subscribers for a specific event notification ID.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Gets a list of employees with a specific role, returning them as Recipient objects.

methods.name: getSelf
methods.description: Returns the recipient object representing the employee themselves.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves recipients for a given email event based on predefined email notification types.

methods.name: getSupervisors
methods.description: Gets the supervisor(s) of the specified employee as Recipient objects.

methods.name: getLeaveDetailsByDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Converts detailed leave data into a summarized array including date, time, and duration.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments associated with a specific leave request.
